```{r}
# Setup
set.seed(123)

# Load and prepare data
data_prediction <- read.csv(here("data", "processed", "weather_wide_pivot.csv"))

data_prediction1 <- data_prediction %>%
  select(-CurrentDate) %>%
  mutate(Location = as.factor(Location))

# Create train/test split (assuming 'Label' is your outcome variable)
train_index <- createDataPartition(data_prediction1$Label, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

data_train <- data_prediction1[train_index, ]
data_test  <- data_prediction1[-train_index, ]

# Fit logistic regression model
model <- glm(Label ~ ., data = data_train, family = binomial)

# View model summary
summary(model)

# Predict on test set
predicted_probs <- predict(model, newdata = data_test, type = "response")
predicted_classes <- ifelse(predicted_probs > 0.0098, 1, 0)

# Confusion matrix
confusionMatrix(as.factor(predicted_classes), as.factor(data_test$Label))

```
